## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      5 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 18 feb 2026 - 22 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _claireac1234_, 18 ago 2026, 1/5: "I’ve been a Forest user for many years now and have always enjoyed the cute trees and the incentive to put my phone down. The new UX that was just rolled out has so many pop-ups and distractions, and is flooding the app with monetization and pushes to pay a premium subscription for an app that I ALREADY PAID FOR. The value of Forest was in part the cost up front for an ad-free, push-free experience. The new UX makes this so much worse by making you go through multiple layers of pop-ups and questions to do a basic function. It has moved the obvious controls to unintuitive locations. Very disappointed to have an app that has been useful (and that I paid for!) ruined like this."
            2. _清辰戌_, 17 ago 2026, 1/5: "The APP is too expensive!!!"
            3. _Noor_75_, 29 jul 2026, 1/5: "Most of us bought the app to have it forever. Now they’re hitting us with the premium suscription, and now ADS???? yall became so greedy"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Presión publicitaria** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Presión publicitaria.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona presión publicitaria.
      Ventana de reseñas: 9 jul 2026 - 17 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios notan presión publicitaria. Señala fricción de monetización y una apertura para un competidor más limpio.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _TDTW!_, 17 ago 2026, 1/5: "The 2026 redesign is clearly meant to promote the paid subscription model and not for ergonomics. The post-session is now multiple screens showing among other unhelpful analytics the option to watch ads to boost reward. The new interface is buggy, slow, bloated, and often unresponsive. Useful features (e.g. adjusting focus time) are hidden behind unnecessary menus. The pay-to-unlock trees are background noise, but you can't ignore the constant nagging to watch ads or pay. The old interface was good precisely because it's minimalistic. I hope paid users can have the option to revert to the old interface. For other frustrated users: you can still use the interface if you turn on plant together. Apparently this feature will be removed once the new interface officially launches. I hope the developers have the decency to leave it in."
            2. _w y_, 9 jul 2026, 1/5: "paid for forest plus and still got ads (not the optional ones for extra rewards)"
<!--/ir-theme-->
